profile.reading: Per CyrusOne own facility page for Council Bluffs, Iowa (OCB1), this facility publishes 9 MW of total IT capacity and a street address of 4700 Gifford Rd. Council Bluffs, IA 51501. CyrusOne own page describes 120,000 square feet of raised floor and white space within a wider 420,000 square foot technical IT space total for the site. Published certifications include PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, HITRUST, SSAE 18, and TIA-942.
profile.research_note:
Only company-level CyrusOne facts confirmed for this cluster; no state or city-specific opening/investment story found this session. Revisit with fresh WebSearch budget.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne was founded in July 2000 by David Ferdman and Larry Bursten, who had previously built companies acquired by IXC Communications. The company was purchased by Cincinnati Bell for 525 million dollars in 2010, completed an IPO in 2013, and was taken private again in 2022 when Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Global Infrastructure Partners acquired it for 15 billion dollars. Sourcing fetched this session gave detailed acquisition stories for several CyrusOne markets, including Texas, Virginia, Ohio, Arizona, Illinois, and Connecticut, but did not contain a specific opening date, investment figure, or building history for this particular state cluster. No building specific address or individual MW figures were located in available sourcing this session.

[session addition 2026-09-03] Fetched CyrusOne own OCB1 facility page fresh this session, confirming the existing 9 MW figure and the 120,000 square foot raised floor and white space figure already on file, and additionally finding a 420,000 square foot technical IT space figure and a 216,000 square foot total footprint figure. The 420,000 figure matches the technical_space_sqft already on file for the parallel record at cyrusone:council-bluffs-ia, indicating the two figures on file across these two records for the same building represent different metrics from the same operator page rather than a conflict, so neither numeric field was changed. Identified this record and cyrusone:council-bluffs-ia as duplicate mappings of the same physical OCB1 building, sharing an identical street address, and applied duplicate_of pointing to cyrusone:council-bluffs-ia. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete.

reading.body:
CyrusOne OCB1 in Council Bluffs publishes 9 MW of IT capacity, which ranks it first among the two Iowa facilities with published power figures and accounts for half of Iowa's 18 MW of operator-disclosed data center IT load across 52 mapped sites statewide. The facility occupies 120,000 square feet of raised floor and white space within a larger 420,000 square foot technical footprint, suggesting room for growth beyond current published capacity.

At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 9 MW of IT load is roughly 225 racks. The facility's certifications qualify it for regulated workloads: PCI DSS compliance for payment systems, HIPAA and HITRUST for health data, FISMA for federal information systems, and TIA-942 for data center physical infrastructure. These certifications do not indicate which tenants occupy the space.

Iowa publishes minimal capacity data across its data center cluster. With only two facilities disclosing power and CyrusOne Council Bluffs representing the larger figure, the state remains undersignaled in regional AI infrastructure mapping. No opening date, investment figure, or power growth trajectory for this specific facility is published.
